verdict.rationale: BAMF is Germany's federal migration and refugee authority. Its evidence covers migration information, integration offers, asylum procedures, advisory service teams and statistics, not a software platform or API. Subscribing to events via registrable outbound HTTP callbacks falls outside this kind of product, so the axis does not apply. Nothing in the pack shows BAMF shipping webhooks or any programmatic event interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
